tools.name: open_now
tools.description: Lists venues within a radius of a point that are open at the given moment (default: now). Hours are either listed or an estimate (basis=estimate).

tools.name: opening_hours
tools.description: Finds a venue by name (optionally near a point or in a city) and returns its regular weekly opening hours: listed, or an estimate (basis=estimate).

tools.name: events
tools.description: Lists public events near a point or in a city within a date range. Each event names its organiser or publisher and licence.

tools.name: rhythm
tools.description: Estimates how busy the surroundings of a point are by hour of a day of the week (index against the place's weekly average, level 1-5, people rounded to tens), the peak hours, and the busiest spots nearby. Always an estimate.

tools.name: sources
tools.description: Returns the covered areas and categories, the date of the data, and the licences with the attribution to use when citing.
